We’re all about 
smart platforms
We’re here to make technology-based communication easy for you. 
With tens of thousands of customers worldwide, our ONLINECITY.IO-family 
connects people and units every day via messaging, IoT connectivity
and virtual numbers.
Get to know us
Contact us
Let’s meet the family
One company, three platforms
Read on to learn more about GatewayAPI, RelationCity, NexCon.io 
and the many services we provide through each platform.
GatewayAPI is our global CPaaS supercharged with a powerful SMS gateway. It simplifies the process of sending business messages by removing the complexity and allowing you to focus on building your projects right away with our intuitive APIs.
 SMS APIs
 Email API
 Virtual number and keywords
 Mobile Message API
Visit GatewayAPI
 
RelationCity is our advanced marketing and communication platform that fits perfectly into your omnichannel marketing strategy and lets you communicate effectively across multiple channels. In short, RelationCity makes it easy to reach your target audience – wherever they are.
 SMS services
 Email services
 RCS services
 RelationCity API
Visit RelationCity
 
NexCon.io provides professional IoT and M2M SIMs and eSIMs that connect your devices to 525+ global networks. With NexCon.io, you can manage all your SIMs in one place and handle communication via data transfer and SMS with ease.
 IoT SIMs
 M2M SIMs
 Physical SIMs
 eSIMs
Visit NexCon.io
 
We are your connection point
At ONLINECITY.IO, we bring together our digital platforms all under one roof, connecting you to powerful solutions that strengthen your business. With us, smarter, faster and more efficient tools are just one click away.
All about us
Since 1999, ONLINECITY.IO has been making digital platforms to power your technology-based communication. We’ve got a rich history and love sharing our journey – take a look behind the scenes, or check out our latest updates on LinkedIn!
Visit us on LinkedIn
One login, full access
All our platforms are all accessible through your OCiD login. This means that you can use one, two or all three platforms through a single account in one convenient place.
Choose your use case
This is how different businesses can use NexCon.io, GatewayAPI and RelationCity  as the perfect toolbox to strengthen their services and products
Telemedicine
Smart home
Logistics
Telemedicine
A patient receives a telemedicine kit with a NexCon.io SIM card. The device securely transmits real-time health data to the provider’s system.
GatewayAPI sends the patient an SMS with a secure link for their upcoming video consultation, plus a reminder 24 hours before.
After the consultation, RelationCity manages ongoing communication: sending care instructions, scheduling follow-ups and gathering feedback.
Smart home
When a customer installs a new smart home device, NexCon.io ensures it’s connected via a reliable IoT SIM card.
GatewayAPI sends an SMS to the customer confirming the setup. It also sends regular security alerts and maintenance reminders.
RelationCity helps create marketing campaigns to upsell additional devices or services based on the customer’s usage patterns.
Logistics
All delivery vehicles are equipped with IoT devices using NexCon.io SIMs, providing real-time location and status data to the central logistics platform.
Customers receive SMS notifications from GatewayAPI with live tracking links, estimated arrival times and updates if the delivery window changes.
Customer service teams use RelationCity to view all shipment and communication histories, manage complaints and ensure proactive follow-ups.

Privacy, security, clarity
Your data is safe with us. All our systems are built with data compliance and security at the core, we receive annual auditor’s statements, and we keep all our policies transparent and available for all.
